name: thapathali-campus-core-intents
description: Baseline L2/L3 intents for the synthetic Thapathali campus core (thapathali_complex.json).

intents.name: Students isolated from exam database
intents.description: No IP traffic from the student lab may reach the examination database.

intents.name: Students reach EMIS portal over HTTPS
intents.description: Student lab hosts must be able to open the EMIS portal over HTTPS.

intents.name: Faculty reach exam database
intents.description: Faculty offices must keep IP reachability to the examination database.

intents.name: Campus core is loop-free
intents.description: The campus core data plane must contain no forwarding loops.
